title: tools.md's intake row does not say a drift check's tests.py run writes its test.run row to the clone's spool
goal: Found in the SP-vmxdxtru review: BG-2uqmyman runs drift checks with bl_base.check_env, which since ST-d35ns45r sets KB_TEST_RUN_HOME, so every SessionStart drift check that runs tests.py -k writes its test.run row into the clone's real spool; backlog.md names that exception, but kb/_self/tools.md's intake row says only that drift checks run with the isolated home. The tools.md intake row names the test.run exception.

run: import pathlib,sys;t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/tools.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');r=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.startswith('| `python3 _tools/backlog.py intake`')][0];ok='test.run' in r;print('intake row names the test.run exception:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
